title: One Event Happens to All

questions.question: The righteous and the wise and their deeds are in whose hand?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:1 (ESV): "how the righteous and the wise and their deeds are in the hand of God."

questions.question: One event happens to whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:2 (ESV): "It is the same for all, since the same event happens to the righteous and the wicked,"

questions.question: For a living dog is better than a what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:4 (ESV): "for a living dog is better than a dead lion."

questions.question: The living know that they will die, but the dead know what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:5 (ESV): "For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing,"

questions.question: Enjoy life with whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:9 (ESV): "Enjoy life with the wife whom you love,"

questions.question: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:10 (ESV): "Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might,"

questions.question: The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:11 (ESV): "the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong,"

questions.question: But time and what happen to them all?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:11 (ESV): "but time and chance happen to them all."

questions.question: Wisdom is better than what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:18 (ESV): "Wisdom is better than weapons of war,"

questions.question: One sinner destroys much what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:18 (ESV): "but one sinner destroys much good."

questions.question: Like fish that are taken in an evil net, so are the children of man snared at an evil what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:12 (ESV): "so the children of man are snared at an evil time,"

questions.question: There was a little city with few men in it, and a great king came against it and built great what against it?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:14 (ESV): "and built great siege works against it."

questions.question: But there was found in it a poor, wise man, and he by his wisdom did what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:15 (ESV): "and he by his wisdom delivered the city."

questions.question: Yet no one remembered that what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:15 (ESV): "Yet no one remembered that poor man."

questions.question: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the shouting of a ruler among whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 9:17 (ESV): "than the shouting of a ruler among fools."

key_verse_text: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might, for there is no work or thought or knowledge or wisdom in Sheol, to which you are going.
